user.title: Connect De’Longhi Account
user.description: Enter your De’Longhi (My Coffee Lounge) credentials to discover your smart appliances.

data_description.device_ip: Leave empty to find the machine on your network. Either way, you confirm it before it receives your sign-in.

select_device.title: Select Appliance
select_device.description: Multiple coffee machines were found linked to your account. Choose the appliance you wish to configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: De’Longhi no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter your current My Coffee Lounge password to reconnect {name}.

local_address.title: Coffee machine not found
local_address.description: Home Assistant didn’t find your coffee machine on the network. Your machine reports its address to De’Longhi as **{reported}**. Check that it’s on and connected to Wi-Fi, then enter its address. Leave it empty to continue without control over your home network; you can confirm the machine later in the integration’s options.

confirm_machine.title: Confirm your coffee machine
confirm_machine.description:
Home Assistant found these devices that look like a coffee machine. Your machine reports its address to De’Longhi as **{reported}**; pick that one if it’s listed.

Only the device you pick receives your De’Longhi sign-in, and Home Assistant then trusts only that exact device.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please verify your credentials and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to De’Longhi cloud services. Please check your network connection.
error.no_devices: No smart coffee machines found linked to this De’Longhi account.
error.unknown: De’Longhi’s sign-in service gave an unexpected answer. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, the Home Assistant log has the details.
error.device_not_on_account: This coffee machine is no longer linked to {username}. Check that it still appears in the My Coffee Lounge app.
error.account_locked: De’Longhi has paused sign-ins for this account after too many attempts. Sign in once in the My Coffee Lounge app, then try again in a few minutes.
error.invalid_address: Enter an IP address on your home network, like 192.168.1.50, without a port or name.
error.machine_refused: That device didn’t accept your De’Longhi sign-in, so it isn’t your coffee machine. Pick another one, or check that your machine is on.

abort.already_configured: This coffee machine is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in. Your coffee machine is reconnected.

progress.searching: Looking for your coffee machine on your network. This takes a few seconds.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often Home Assistant checks De’Longhi’s cloud, and confirming your coffee machine.

data_description.confirm_machine: Find your machine on the network and confirm it, e.g. after resetting it. Only the device you confirm receives your De’Longhi sign-in.

command_no_local_address.message: Add your coffee machine’s IP address in the integration’s options to control it.

command_not_connected.message: Not connected to the coffee machine on your home network. Check that it’s plugged in and on Wi-Fi.

command_rejected.message: The coffee machine declined. It may be busy or already in that state.

command_unauthorized.message: The coffee machine refused the connection. Try again in a moment.

command_no_reply.message: The coffee machine didn’t answer. Check that it’s on and connected to Wi-Fi.

command_connection_lost.message: The connection to the coffee machine dropped. Try again in a moment.

cannot_brew_now.message: The coffee machine isn’t ready for a drink: it needs to be on and ready, with no tank, grounds or beans alert, and reachable on your home network.

settings_not_known.message: The coffee machine’s current settings aren’t known yet. Try again once it has reported them.

machine_identity_changed.title: Coffee machine’s identity changed
machine_identity_changed.description:
The device at your coffee machine’s address isn’t the machine Home Assistant trusts, so Home Assistant won’t send it your De’Longhi sign-in.

Unless you know you reset or re-paired {name}, treat this as suspicious: something on your network may be posing as it. If you did reset it, open the integration’s options and turn on **Confirm the coffee machine**, then pick the device at the address your machine reports to De’Longhi.

machine_not_confirmed.title: Confirm your coffee machine
machine_not_confirmed.description: Home Assistant can control {name} over your home network once you’ve confirmed which device it is. Open the integration’s options and turn on **Confirm the coffee machine**.

machine_refuses_account.title: Coffee machine refuses your account
machine_refuses_account.description: {name} no longer accepts your De’Longhi sign-in, even a fresh one. It may have been reset or removed from your account in the My Coffee Lounge app. Home Assistant will try again in an hour; if you reset it, add it to your account in the app again.
